description:
Languages spoken at home: English only, 36 other languages from Mandarin to Nepali, and English proficiency, as counts and shares for every suburb and council area.

Coverage: About 11,000 suburbs and localities and 545 council areas across Australia, in all states and territories (areas with too few residents for reliable figures are left out); one snapshot at 10 August 2021. Current to 2021-08-10. Full description, field list and method: `/v1/datasets/languages`.

**Price: 5¢ per call.**

fields.description: Comma-separated subset of: total_population, english_only_count, english_only_pct, other_language_any_count, other_language_any_pct, english_poor_count, english_poor_pct, not_stated_count, not_stated_pct, chinese_languages_count, chinese_languages_pct, mandarin_count, mandarin_pct, cantonese_count, cantonese_pct, arabic_count, arabic_pct, vietnamese_count, vietnamese_pct, punjabi_count, punjabi_pct, greek_count, greek_pct, italian_count, italian_pct, hindi_count, hindi_pct, spanish_count, spanish_pct, nepali_count, nepali_pct, tagalog_count, tagalog_pct, korean_count, korean_pct, urdu_count, urdu_pct, tamil_count, tamil_pct, filipino_count, filipino_pct, sinhalese_count, sinhalese_pct, gujarati_count, gujarati_pct, malayalam_count, malayalam_pct, australian_indigenous_languages_count, australian_indigenous_languages_pct, indonesian_count, indonesian_pct, persian_count, persian_pct, french_count, french_pct, german_count, german_pct, bengali_count, bengali_pct, portuguese_count, portuguese_pct, thai_count, thai_pct, macedonian_count, macedonian_pct, turkish_count, turkish_pct, japanese_count, japanese_pct, serbian_count, serbian_pct, russian_count, russian_pct, croatian_count, croatian_pct, afrikaans_count, afrikaans_pct, samoan_count, samoan_pct, polish_count, polish_pct, khmer_count, khmer_pct. Omit for all.

lga_name.description: Council (LGA) name exactly as /v1/lga/list returns it, e.g. `Lake Macquarie`.

to.description: Last period to include, same formats as `from`.
